messages:
Lina G.: Kicking off day0 provisioning for the cloud marketplace listing. Goal: account access, artifact buckets, pricing SKUs, and legal templates in one place. Who can take ownership of each cloud?
Omar B.: Ill do AWS onboarding (publisher account + listings). Need partner billing email and preferred AWS region.
Tessa M.: Ill handle Azure publisher flow and image packaging (VHD vs managed image). Also note Azure requires a support contact phone number.
Rohit (Prod): Ill own GCP image hosting + the pricing tiers doc (will draft sample tiers for seat-based, usage-minute, and trial SKU).
Jules (Legal): Legal quick note: we need the exact company name for the marketplace contract, plus any logo trademark usage constraints. Also, if the partner wants revenue share terms shown, we need their approval.
Lina G.: Thanks. Proposed minimal checklist: 1) Publisher org id & admin email, 2) IAM/service account roles, 3) S3/GCS/Azure storage naming and ACLs, 4) thumbnail/artifact sizes, 5) trial SKU mappings, 6) legal contact + DPA/EULA confirm. Add anything?
Omar B.: Add: cross-account IAM role name convention -> `RedwoodMarketplacePublisherRole`, and an S3 lifecycle policy to expire test artifacts after 30 days.
Tessa M.: Add: Azure listing needs localized terms toggle + marketplace SKU entitlement mapping. Also confirm whether we deliver an ARM template or managed image? Partner prefers ARM + SAS link for quick deploy.
Rohit (Prod): For GCP, I recommend bucket `redwood-marketplace-<env>-<partner>-<region>` and Pub/Sub topic `marketplace-billing-events` for metering callbacks. Will provide terraform snippet.
Lina G.: Cool. @Jules any issues with the ARM + SAS approach?
Jules (Legal): No legal blockers with ARM; SAS links must be time-limited and the partner must confirm data residency constraints. Also prepare a DMCA contact for the listing page.
MarketplaceBot: Created ticket MPL-991 and assigned to partnerships.team. https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/MPL-991
Omar B.: Quick IAM policy sketch for AWS cross-account role (keep minimal):
```
Version: "2012-10-17"
Statement:
  - Effect: Allow
    Action:
      - s3:PutObject
      - s3:GetObject
      - s3:ListBucket
    Resource: arn:aws:s3:::redwood-marketplace-*
```
Rohit (Prod): Sample pricing tiers Ill post in the product folder. Short form: Free trial 14d (trial SKU), Starter $99/mo, Pro $499/mo, Enterprise custom.
Tessa M.: Design assets: partner sent logo 600x200 PNG; we need 1920x1080 and 1280x720 for different stores. Can design rescale and give a transparent SVG?
Lina G.: Action owners: Omar -> AWS invites + lifecycle policy; Tessa -> Azure ARM + assets + phone contact; Rohit -> GCP bucket + pricing doc + terraform; Jules -> finalize EULA/DPA + DMCA contact. I'll collect partner legal name + billing email and post here by EOD.
Omar B.: Target dates: publisher invites by Tue EOD, images and ARM by Wed, pricing + legal sign-off by Fri. Is that ok?
Jules (Legal): Fri sign-off ok if we get the publisher legal name and any localization requirements by Wed noon.
Lina G.: Great. Ill ping the partner now and update this thread when they reply. :white_check_mark:
MarketplaceBot: Reminder set for MPL-991 on 2026-03-25 10:00 UTC.
